\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Translation-closed function classes]
\lean{FABL.IsTranslationClosed}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p167-b004}
\label{FABL.IsTranslationClosed}
\leanok
A class $C$ of real-valued functions on the Boolean cube $^n$ is translation-closed if,
whenever $f \mathbin C$ and $z \mathbin ^n$, the function $x mapsto f(x+z)$ also belongs to $C$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Approximation by a Probability Density]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.Fools}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p160-b003,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p167-b004
}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.Fools}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expectation}
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a nonnegative probability density of
uniform expectation one on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let $C$ be a set of real-valued functions
on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. The density $\varphi$ fools $C$
to error $\varepsilon$ if, for every $f\in C$, the absolute difference between the
expectation of $f$ under $\varphi$ and its uniform expectation is at most $\varepsilon$.
\end{definition}

\difficulty{5}
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\psi$ and $\varphi$ be probability densities on
$\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of $f$ under
their convolution equals the uniform expectation over $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$ of
$\varphi(z)$ times the expectation under $\psi$ of the function $y\mapsto f(y+z)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Translation invariance of uniform expectation]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_translate_add}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_translate_add}
\leanok
\difficulty{1}
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let
$z\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The uniform expectation of $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ equals the uniform
expectation of $f$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Convolution preserves fooling]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.Fools.convolution_right}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.Fools.convolution_right}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.IsTranslationClosed, FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.Fools, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.convolution, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_eq_one, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_translate_add, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expectation, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expectation_convolution, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.nonneg}
\difficulty{5}
Let $C$ be a translation-closed class of real-valued functions on the Boolean cube
$\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. If a probability density $\psi$
fools every function in $C$ with error at most $\varepsilon$, then for every probability
density $\phi$, the convolution of $\psi$ with $\phi$ also fools every function in $C$
with error at most $\varepsilon$.
\end{theorem}
